description_en: Modifies the name and description of a HaVip
description_zh: 调用ModifyHaVipAttribute接口修改HaVip的名称和描述
kebab_example: aliyun vpc modify-ha-vip-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --ha-vip-id havip-2zeo05qre24nhrqp0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyHaVipAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request is different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the HaVip.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
HaVip所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the HaVip that you want to modify
parameters.name: ha_vip_id

parameters.help_en:
The description of the HaVip.

The description must be 1 to 255 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
HaVip的描述。

描述长度为1～255个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The name of the HaVip.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
HaVip的名称。

名称长度为1～128个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: name
